pictures.author: Radler59
pictures.notes: Bridge-side view: tall stone rectangular tower, steep truncated hip/ridge slate roof with two finials, four slender corner turrets and pierced/open gallery; large blind tracery on the bridge facade. Lower southern tower has a broad steep slate roof, two poles and a stepped/dormer facade. The towers are physically joined by a genuine pointed arch gate with low crenellations. Neighboring cream/red-roof houses and bridge statuary are separate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific connected Mala Strana bridge-side compound: tall stone Gothic tower with blind tracery, open upper gallery/four corner turrets, steep closed slate hip roof/two finials; lower southern tower with its distinct steep slate roof/stepped dormer; genuine open pointed connecting gate and selected crenellations/blank geometric plaques. Four existing shared sandstone/raw-stone/slate/paint graphs, original simplified relief and closed window/door insets. No complete Charles Bridge, copied heraldry/text/photos, neighboring houses, bridge statues or furnished interior.
